Local Work

Three Aberdeen Floors

These are three of our own job write-ups from Aberdeen, in our words.

Aberdeen

Engineered Oak Flooring Installation

Fairmont Flooring recently undertook an engineered wood flooring installation for a homeowner looking to transform their existing interior. The original flooring was dated and required upgrading to achieve a more modern, elegant appearance. We assessed the existing subfloor, completed the necessary preparation and installed premium engineered oak flooring, ensuring accurate alignment, neat perimeter detailing and professional finishing throughout. The project was completed over approximately 2 to 3 days, leaving the customer with a beautiful natural wood finish that significantly enhanced the appearance of their home.

Engineered Wood Flooring

Aberdeen

Luxury Herringbone Flooring Installation

Fairmont Flooring undertook a bespoke herringbone flooring installation for a homeowner looking to introduce a more luxurious and timeless finish to their property. The project involved careful subfloor preparation, detailed measurements and precise setting out to achieve a perfectly balanced herringbone pattern. We installed premium engineered oak herringbone flooring, paying close attention to alignment, pattern consistency, perimeter cuts and finishing details. The completed installation transformed the space, creating an elegant, high-end appearance with the natural warmth and character of real wood.

Herringbone Flooring

Aberdeen

Laminate Flooring Transformation

Fairmont Flooring recently undertook a laminate flooring installation for a homeowner looking to modernise their property. The existing flooring was tired and showing signs of wear, so we recommended a fresh, contemporary finish. Our team assessed the subfloor, completed the necessary preparation and installed quality laminate flooring, paying close attention to accurate measurements, expansion gaps, doorways and finishing trims. The completed installation provided a clean, modern appearance with a durable and practical surface suitable for everyday family life.

Laminate Flooring
